key.name: flatpak-steam
key.summary: Add Flatpak Steam games to the app grid and search
key.description: Mirrors the game shortcuts of Steam from Flathub (com.valvesoftware.Steam) into ~/.local/share/applications as steam-flatpak-*.desktop files with a working Exec line. Turning it off removes them again.

key.name: flatpak-bottles
key.summary: Add programs from Flatpak Bottles to the app grid and search
key.description: Writes a shortcut for every program of every bottle of Bottles from Flathub (com.usebottles.bottles) into ~/.local/share/applications as bottles-flatpak-*.desktop files, since Bottles can't create them from its sandbox. Turning it off removes them again.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Write debug details to the system journal
key.description: Logs how each window was matched, which icons were replaced, what the shortcut mirrors wrote and how long it took, prefixed "Icon Fix:". Errors are logged either way.

key.name: debug-watching
key.description: Set by the preferences while they are open: Icon Fix then records how GNOME picks each window's app for the Debug tab, in ~/.cache/icon-fix/debug/trace.jsonl, and removes it when they close.
